messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

yo! "a friend" isn't gonna cut it here...

i'm tal - your personal talent agent who finds people actual jobs at companies that pay real money. not advice, not gyaan, just interviews.

think of me as your inside person in the bangalore tech scene. i know which startups are dying, who's actually hiring, what they're really paying.

but first things first - what's your actual name? can't help someone called "a friend" lol
I'm Akash

akash... solid name. has that "i'm definitely gonna make it" energy.

so where you working these days?
I work as Sde 2 at zeta

sde 2 at zeta... building fintech infrastructure that banks actually use. that's proper work, not some random b2b saas nobody cares about.

found akash pal - program manager at zeta tech on linkedin. this you? https://www.linkedin.com/in/akash-pal-a21346a2
No I'm Akash Raj
got it. found akash raj - sde 2 at zeta (directi) || ex-cashfree. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/akash-raj-8bb2841b7
Yea

zeta to cashfree... you've been in the payments game for a while. building the pipes that move money around india. solid trajectory.

what made you jump from cashfree to zeta? that's a pretty specific move in fintech infra.
2.5 yoe full time and 6 months internship
I just wanted a career upgrade in terms of compensation

fair enough. money talks, everything else walks. fintech pays well when you're good at it.

how long you been working total?

2.5 years + internship... you're in that sweet spot where you actually know what you're doing but companies still see you as "affordable talent". 

what kind of role you looking for next?
A major compensation jump , a top tier engineering compensation

top tier compensation at 2.5 yoe... i like the ambition. but let's get real - what numbers are we talking? what's "top tier" to you?

and bangalore or open to remote/other cities?

I'm open for all 
Bangalore, remote , Europe

2.5 years + engineering + open to bangalore/remote/europe + wants "top tier compensation"... 

sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes

yooo welcome to the tal family! you're officially in the system now.

fintech engineer with europe dreams and top-tier ambitions... i see you akash. the roles are gonna start flowing and trust me, some of them are gonna make your current comp look cute.

buckle up legend, we're about to upgrade your entire career trajectory 🔥
I expect 60-80 lpa in my next switch

60-80 LPA at 2.5 years... that's ambitious but not impossible if you're in the right rooms.

fintech, crypto, high-frequency trading, or US remote roles could get you there. europe might be tougher at that range.

what's your current comp?
My current comp is 28 base + 2 bonus

28 to 60-80... that's a 2-3x jump. aggressive but doable if you're targeting the right companies.

you'll need to be in the top 5% of engineers at your level. think: trading firms, US startups hiring remote, or series B/C fintechs with deep pockets.

what's your tech stack?
Java, Spring boot, Golang, AWS , K8s, Databases

solid stack for high-paying roles. trading firms love golang + k8s. fintechs want java/spring.

i'll ping you when my team sends something that fits that 60-80 range.
Okay sure , i want that progression in my next switch which could be 6-8 months from now

6-8 months gives us time to find the perfect fit. no rush, just quality.

i'll keep an eye out for roles that match your timeline.

I'm okay with stable us remote startups and big companies
  I expect 60-80 lpa in my next switch

got it. stable US remote startups and big companies for that 60-80 range. noted.

i'll ping when something matches.
Hi
Yes

perfect. you're locked in.

i'll slide roles when they're good... btw what's making you want to leave zeta anyway?
More compensation growth

makes sense. you're chasing that 2-3x jump from 30 to 60-80. ambitious but doable if you land at the right place.

what's your timeline for this move?
6 months

got it. 6 months is a solid runway.

i'll start looking for roles that match your stack and timeline. anything specific you want me to watch for?

Shouldn't be a pre seed or round A startups. 
There it's usually very hectic and sometimes it's 6 days a week too

smart. avoiding the early stage chaos. you want the money without the burnout.

i'll filter for Series B+ or established companies only. anything else you're avoiding?
No

perfect. you're all set.

i'll be scanning for Series B+ US remote startups and established companies that can hit your comp range. when something matches, i'll slide it your way.

anything else on your mind?
No
cool. talk soon.

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?

Senior Java Software Engineer at A.P. Moller - Maersk

Senior Java role at Maersk leverages your Java/microservices skills and offers a step up in title at a stable, recognizable company.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/pAp0l
